modularMaps.classic: Create a TRANSPARENT sprite sheet of FOUR separate environment props extracted/adapted faithfully from the attached existing game art. This is for rebuilding that same map as individually movable Unity sprites. Preserve recognizable original shapes and proportions, do not redesign the setting. Layout exactly 2 columns by 2 rows, one object per quadrant, generous transparent gutters between every sprite and canvas edges. No overlaps between quadrants. No labels, no text, no scene background, no board, no checkerboard drawn into the alpha. Each prop fully visible. Front facing shallow 2.5D parallel projection: horizontal bases, symmetric front faces, just a little visible top surface. Fine crisp pixel art matching the original screenshot, NOT enlarged coarse mosaic pixels; no blur, no gradients/airbrush/photorealism. Slightly desaturated daytime palette, soft controlled highlights, not dark nighttime. No baked floor patches, no giant cast shadows, only tight contact shading within each prop. Entire output transparent square sprite atlas. TOP LEFT: the complete wide blue/yellow/red inflatable castle arch with its two short rounded towers from the reference, centered frontal entrance, retaining the familiar yellow face, blue feet/turrets and red arch. TOP RIGHT: one original wooden toy shelf containing small toys and blocks, front view. BOTTOM LEFT: a compact group of the original foam blocks and three small colored balls, low and wide. BOTTOM RIGHT: a gently hanging string of triangular yellow, blue, muted coral and purple bunting flags, only the string and flags.
